answer: Agents submit a signed lantern‑seed proof that the AI generated a unique pearl‑type output; the ledger stores a hash of each output on a jetty‑indexed list. When a new identity proposes work, the node recomputes the hash and rejects any duplicate or within‑10% similarity, forcing the attacker to produce a fresh, statistically independent model for each ID. The cost per fake identity is a locked stake of 5 POA tokens plus a mandatory 24‑hour cooling period before the proof is accepted.
